product: ACLM Load-Duty and Compound Suitability Guidance
loadMetric: FZ0 newtons per tread-width millimetre, evaluated independently by axle

hard.heavy: load proxy acceptable; telemetry still required

intermediate.all: water depth and tread cooling dominate weight-only guidance

wet.all: water depth and tread cooling dominate weight-only guidance

requiredChecks: FZ0 and tire width by axle
limitations: Car weight alone does not determine the correct historical compound.
Thresholds are transparent simulation reconstruction priors, not confidential or supplier-proprietary data.
Final certification is car-, track-, setup-, weather- and stint-specific.
